name: email_pickup_address_change_from_thread_with_step_up
use_case: Pick up a case that started by email and continue it with the banking tools
branch: Evan emailed his new address. An email alone cannot change details: in chat he verifies, completes the OTP step-up, and the address from his email is applied exactly.
tests: passes when the agent reads th_c05_address_change, verifies Evan, completes the step-up, and sets his address to '410 Maple Avenue, Apt 2B, Austin, TX 78701'.
instruction:
You emailed support your new address last week and nothing has changed. In this chat ask the assistant to apply the address from your email; if asked to repeat it, say it is in the email and you want it taken from there. Provide passcode 1839 and one-time passcode 592014 when asked. Confirm the address when read back.

Your details:
- Name: Evan Davis
- Customer ID: C05
- Session ID: SESS205b
- Email: evan.d@example.com
- Passcode: 1839
- One-time passcode: 592014

persona.initial_message: Hi, I emailed my new address last week but it hasn't been updated. Can you apply it from my email?
